trophies.guide: The platinum lands on its own once every other trophy is earned — there is no separate task. Work through the roadmap below and tick things off as you go; the platinum pops with the last one.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so this unlocks naturally as the story starts.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its final mission. Nothing here is missable — just follow the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. The trophy pops when the chapter's last mission ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Clear Chapter 3's mission line. Keep an eye on side content as you go, but the chapter itself is unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to the end. This is the last story chapter before the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Gold, and the last story trophy before the platinum — make sure the one missable trophy is done before the finale.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It comes up in the mission flow, so just keep playing.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission when it appears in the story. No special preparation needed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish the Child's Play mission. Story-only, unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. Part of the main story path.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish the VCIA Takedown mission. It unlocks as the story reaches the airport arc.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission. Story-only.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the stats screen: story, side strands, activities, collectibles, exploration and money goals all count. This is the long grind — use this checklist as the plan, and leave it until everything else is nearly done.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long airtime and high-speed driving all feed the counter. Weave stunt attempts into normal driving instead of grinding them in one sitting; the counter is cumulative.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, races, shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling and the rest. One try each is enough — you do not need to win.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's rhythm, use the right weapon for the drill, and replay the ones you silver until they click — gold is about accuracy and steady pacing, not speed.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn the gates on each course, cut corners where the track allows, and use boost on the long straights.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the race types. Any win counts per race, so pick the shortest events first and vary your vehicle to match the class.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Watch the line tension, reel in when the fish runs toward you, and keep the rod steady — the challenge is a patience game, not a power one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at any arcade cabinet. Pick a short one and play it through to the end screen.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Contact missions unlock as the story progresses, so keep checking back with Andy between chapters.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. His missions open up over the story — clear them whenever they appear.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Work through his mission line as it unlocks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map — take each strand to its end, and sweep the map again after each chapter since new strands unlock as the story advances.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Clear his jobs as they appear in the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. His line unlocks alongside the story — do not leave it until after the finale.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Some spots sit in areas that change as the story advances, so clear them as you explore each region instead of leaving them for post-game cleanup. This is the only trophy that can be missed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until the hunt opens, track the animal patiently, and take the shot when it holds still.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — check shops, hidden corners and mission rewards, and trade duplicates where you can.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK spots are spread across the map — work through them region by region and use the checklist to track which areas are done.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more — they accumulate naturally, so check the challenges menu often and mop up the easy ones late.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Get the heat up together, then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and hide until the stars clear — alleys and the water help.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route with three close shops, keep a fast car ready, and move fast between them — do not stop to fight.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive everything you see — each new model counts once, so vary your rides and visit different neighborhoods and vehicle spots.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus. Find a group, trigger focus when they cluster, and chain headshots — tight spaces with several enemies are the best setup.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Grab a plane on the airfield and get airborne without following the usual route — speed matters more than stealth here.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. Use explosives and heavy weapons from cover, keep moving, and do not trade shots in the open.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, watch the cameras and guards, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm — a silent approach beats a loud one.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Plan the getaway before you go in — a fast car, a route away from police, and a clean exit each time. Five vaults, five clean escapes.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the cash, and lose the heat — a second vehicle stashed nearby makes the escape much easier.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive every road and visit every corner — the map fills in as you go, and the last few areas are usually the remote ones.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs. Hit a different gang's operation each time and expect heavy resistance — go in prepared.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the beachside spot, order a drink, and take in the view — a quiet story moment.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Pick a showroom, pick a fast car, and go straight through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. A full game counts — aim for the pocket and follow through.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This one comes from playing through the partner story — it unlocks as your partnership grows.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Make choices along the way. The game tracks the decisions you make — keep playing and choosing, and this pops as the count builds.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. If something fails once, try it again — the second attempt is the one that counts.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Keep your eyes open while exploring Leonida's odd corners — strange things happen when you least expect them.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. Line up a slow pass with a melee weapon ready and swing as you roll past.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Run marked bills through your contacts steadily — it adds up across many jobs, so start early.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades all count — big purchases late in the game finish this off fast.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Save up and purchase them as they become available — they also give you storage for the vehicle collection.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the app, and register each one — variety counts, duplicates do not.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
